intro.heading: A gharana of learning in the heart of Jaipur
intro.text: Fankaar, the word itself means "artist." Founded by Kathak exponent Vartika Tiwari, our institute carries the guru-shishya tradition into modern Jaipur. We offer rigorous yet joyful training in Kathak and Hindustani classical music for learners aged 6 to 70. Whether you are taking your first step onto the dance floor or returning to a long-held dream, there is a place for you at Fankaar.
